composition: Limestone track and the north seating bank · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The stadium sits above the sanctuary: a long track, twelve tiers of seats cut into the north slope, a curved west end, and a lower south terrace. The morning is partly cloudy, cloud cover about 24 percent, about 16.6°C, and dry. The Tholos of Athena Pronaia and the Temple of Apollo are lower on the site and are not in the frame.
